explanation: Born Józef Teodor Konrad Korzeniowski to Polish parents in 1857, he learned French next and took up English only in his twenties, as a merchant seaman.

claims.text: Joseph Conrad's first language was Polish.
English, Russian and French were not Conrad's first language; he learned French and English later.
Conrad was born Józef Teodor Konrad Korzeniowski to Polish parents in 1857.
Conrad learned English only in his twenties, while serving as a merchant seaman.
